def find6x3():
    seg=current_frame.segmentation
    for n in seg['nodes']:
        if n['color']=='N' and n['pixels']==16:
            b=n['boundary']
            # 6x3 is 3 wide 6 tall
            w=b[0][1]; 
            cols=set(x[1] for x in b); rows=set(x[0] for x in b)
            if (max(rows)-min(rows))>=5 and (max(cols)-min(cols))<=2:
                return (min(rows),max(rows),min(cols),max(cols))
    return None
print('before', find6x3())
r=action(['LEFT'])
print('after LEFT', find6x3(), 'changed', last_action_result['board_changed'])

def find6x3():
    seg=current_frame.segmentation
    for n in seg['nodes']:
        if n['color']=='N' and n['pixels']==16:
            b=n['boundary']
            # 6x3 is 3 wide 6 tall

            cols=set(x[1] for x in b); rows=set(x[0] for x in b)
            if (max(rows)-min(rows))>=5 and (max(cols)-min(cols))<=2:
                return (min(rows),max(rows),min(cols),max(cols))
    return None
